verdict.rationale: ELSTER's own docs say powers of attorney (Vollmachten) can be filed electronically with the tax office. They also name one delegate role, the Postfachvertreter, who can view inbox messages within an organisation. That confirms delegation exists, but nothing in the pack publishes what a third party may or may not do in detail. Missing for 10: published authorization forms and their scope, a full roles catalogue with permissions, documentation of which declarations or signatures must remain personal, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal

citations.quote: Sie können Vollmachten elektronisch bei Ihrem Finanzamt einreichen.
Innerhalb einer Organisation können Postfachvertreter benannt werden, um Nachrichten im Posteingang einzusehen.
